note: Hand-edited estimates used to judge which comp styles a player's gold, level, HP and stage can still reach. xpToLevel is the XP needed to reach each level from the one below; the player is assumed to have banked bankedXpShare of the next level's XP, since the app does not ask. lossDamage is a typical loss by stage, and lossRate is how often a player greeding toward a style is assumed to lose. Each style rolls at rollLevel and needs rollGold to roll once there; it should get there by ideal and must by deadline.
